Folder : sync_to_synapse

Folder_SyncToSynapse.Rd

Upload files to Synapse using a manifest CSV file.

Accepts manifests produced by synSyncFromSynapse(), synDownloadListFiles(), or the Synapse UI download cart. The manifest must have at minimum a path and parentId column. All other columns that are not part of the standard manifest column set are treated as file annotations.

Standard manifest columns: ID, name, parentId, contentType, path, synapseStore, activityName, activityDescription, forceVersion, used, executed

Usage

synSyncToSynapse(instance, manifest_path, dry_run=FALSE, send_messages=TRUE, retries=4L, merge_existing_annotations=TRUE, associate_activity_to_new_version=FALSE, synapse_client=NULL)

Arguments

instance

(Folder) The Folder instance to operate on.

manifest_path

(character) Path to the CSV manifest file.

dry_run

(logical) If TRUE, perform full validation of the manifest (including verifying that all parent containers exist in Synapse) but skip the actual file upload.

send_messages

(logical) If TRUE, send a Synapse notification message on completion.

retries

(integer) Number of notification retries (only relevant when send_messages=TRUE).

merge_existing_annotations

(logical) If TRUE, merge manifest annotations with existing annotations on Synapse. If FALSE, overwrite them.

associate_activity_to_new_version

(logical) If TRUE and a version update occurs, the existing Synapse activity is associated with the new version.

synapse_client

(Optional[Synapse]) If not passed in, the last created instance from the Synapse class constructor will be used.

Value

List of File entities that were created or updated. Returns an empty list if dry_run=TRUE or if no rows were eligible for upload.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Using this function
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    folder = Folder(id = "syn12345")
    uploaded = folder |> synSyncToSynapse(manifest_path = "/path/to/manifest.csv")
} # }
